welcomePage.title: The decentralized standard for truth seeking
welcomePage.subtitle: d-FCT combines multi-modal content analysis, explainable AI assistance, community validation, on-chain provenance, tokenized incentives, and governance workflows to make fact-checking transparent, auditable, and participatory.
welcomePage.authTitle: Sign in to verify, vote, and govern
welcomePage.authBody: Use your account or Cardano wallet to submit topics, contribute evidence, and participate in decentralized validation.

lifecycle.title: From content submission to community-reviewed claims
lifecycle.body: d-FCT treats AI as an explainable analysis layer, not a final oracle. Claims, evidence, reviews, and workflow states remain visible to the community.

items.title: Multi-modal submission
items.body: Users submit URLs, images, video, audio, or text so the system can analyze heterogeneous content sources.

items.title: Claim extraction and metadata
items.body: AI pipelines extract candidate claims and semantic metadata that help structure the verification process.

items.title: Explainable AI analysis
items.body: Models provide transparent assistance and evidence organization while leaving final validation to governed workflows.

items.title: Evidence contribution
items.body: Participants add supporting or contrary evidence, references, and contextual information.

items.title: Community validation
items.body: Members vote on claims and evidence through a state-machine-governed verification process.

items.title: On-chain records
items.body: Critical verification stages can be anchored on-chain to preserve provenance and auditability.

infrastructure.title: Transparent coordination instead of closed moderation
infrastructure.body: The d-FCT ecosystem is designed around auditable provenance, incentive alignment, and governance mechanisms that communities can inspect and improve.

items.title: Immutable provenance
items.body: Verification events and state transitions can be recorded as transparent references for later auditing.

items.title: Reward-driven participation
items.body: $DFCT incentives can reward timely, high-quality contributions based on reputation and impact.

items.title: Decentralized governance
items.body: Community members can manage platform parameters and proposal lifecycles through smart-contract-backed workflows.

items.title: Hybrid architecture
items.body: Large files and AI outputs remain off-chain while blockchain records preserve transparent references and execution history.

comparison.title: A fact-checking ecosystem built for auditability
comparison.body: Traditional platforms often centralize decisions. d-FCT separates analysis, evidence, voting, provenance, incentives, and governance into visible workflow layers.

rows.dfct: On-chain audit trails and visible verification states
Tokenized reward pools for valuable contributions

rows.traditional: Black-box decisions and opaque moderation logic

cta.title: Help make public claims easier to inspect
cta.body: Submit content, review evidence, vote on claims, and participate in decentralized governance.

footer.title: Decentralized fact-checking, built for public trust
footer.body: A verification ecosystem where AI structures the analysis, communities inspect the evidence, and blockchain records preserve the trail.
